content:
The registered legal entity has a version and legal_name. A collection account has its own bank_version and bank_legal_name, which can lag after a valid registry change.

propose_bank_identity_sync updates that one account after 20 minutes. The synchronization applies only to the selected account.

Platform display names and a collection account label are not substitutes for legal identity. A change to one bank profile does not change historical certificates.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_bank_identity_sync`

Synchronize one bank account profile to the current registered legal identity.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | yes | The account used by this operation. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
